review.summary: Fix for two JET-detected runtime dispatches that cause test failures on Julia LTS (1.10). The issue describes concrete test failures in the QA suite on Julia 1.10 due to real inference problems in production code (src/KLU/klu.jl and src/SupernodalLU/solve.jl). The fix addresses existing behavior violations (JET tests passing on 1.12 but failing on 1.10).
review.evidence: Issue #1134 provides clear reproduction steps showing JET test failures on Julia 1.10 with specific error messages: runtime dispatch in `KLU._extract!` at src/KLU/klu.jl:246 and `Int(refine::Symbol)` dispatch in src/SupernodalLU/solve.jl:280. The commit modifies exactly these two production files plus their corresponding test files. The failures are in an existing test suite (GROUP=QA) that passes on 1.12 but fails on 1.10, constituting a real defect in inference/type-stability.
